music: Existing channel theme quietly under narration; a brief pause before each mechanism reveal; no science-fiction stings and no checkout beeps.
mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Quiet Roman street in daylight: a few sandals on paving stones, a distant cart, low voices. No modern traffic, no market shouting.
A plain ceramic bowl set down once on a stone counter. No clink of glass.
Three slow footsteps climbing a stone stair outdoors, soft leather soles. No echo chamber.
Quiet enclosed heated room: faint drip, slight hollow resonance, no voices or splashing crowd.
Soft contained wood-fire crackle in a masonry furnace mouth. No roaring blaze.
Two pieces of split wood placed onto a stack by hand, dry knock. No chopping.
A single light bronze coin landing on a small metal plate, one clean tick. No jangle.
A short gentle stream of water into a shallow bowl, two seconds, then stopping. No tap or splash spectacle.
A single coin sliding off a plate and dropping into a wooden box, one soft knock. No rattle.
A small altar flame burning steadily with a faint flutter. No bonfire.
Two small wooden doors swinging open slowly on wooden pivots, a quiet creak. No modern motor or metal squeal.
Two small wooden doors swinging shut slowly and meeting with a soft wooden tap. No slam.
